content:
🚨 Breaking: The Supreme Court has prohibited the uploading, sharing, or circulation of audio and video recordings of court proceedings without prior permission.

The directive aims to safeguard the dignity of judicial proceedings and prevent unauthorized dissemination of court hearing recordings.
